command.name: security key-manager show-key-store
command.description: This command is deprecated. Use the "security key-manager keystore show" command to display all keystore configurations instead.

parameter.name: vserver
parameter.description: If you specify this parameter, then the command will list the key manager configured for the given Vserver.

parameter.name: key-store
parameter.description: If you specify this parameter, then the command displays only the vservers that have the given key-store configured.

parameter.name: keystore-type
parameter.description: If you specify this parameter, then the command displays only the vservers that have the given keystore-type configured. This parameter is used to specify a particular type of external key manager. If this parameter is specified and 'key-store' is provided as 'onboard', the "security key-manager show-key-store" command will not return any entries.

parameter.name: state
parameter.description: If you specify this parameter, then the command displays only the vservers that have the given state configured.

parameter.name: policy
parameter.description: If you specify this parameter, then the command displays only the vservers that have the given policy.

example.p: The following example shows all configured key managers in the cluster. In the example, the admin vserver has the Onboard Key Manager configured and the data vserver "datavs1" has external key management configured:
example.screen:
cluster-1::> security key-manager show-key-store
Vserver Key Store Key Store Type ---------------------- --------- -------------- cluster-1 onboard - datavs1 external AKV
